title: Fundamentals of Astrodynamics and Applications (4th Edition)
author: David A. Vallado
exact_claim_supported: Standard conversion formulas between Cartesian state and classical orbital elements with singularity handling.
limitations: Theoretical formulation; assumes Newtonian two-body mechanics and standard definitions.

title: Department of Defense World Geodetic System 1984 (NIMA TR8350.2)
author: NIMA Geodesy Team
exact_claim_supported: Authoritative WGS-84 reference ellipsoid parameters: gravitational parameter GM; equatorial radius a; flattening f; J2 harmonic.
limitations: Defines static reference ellipsoid; does not include time-varying tidal variations.

title: General Mission Analysis Tool (GMAT) Mathematical Specification
author: Dr. Steven P. Hughes et al.
exact_claim_supported: Mathematical equations for central body point-mass gravity; J2 zonal harmonic perturbation; Runge-Kutta 8(9) integrator.
limitations: Reference manual for GMAT R2026a internal propagator equations.

title: Gravity Fields of the Earth (NASA SP-8007)
author: NASA Langley Research Center
exact_claim_supported: Formulation of gravitational potential and J2 zonal harmonic acceleration in Earth-centered inertial coordinates.
limitations: Truncated to J2 zonal harmonic for low-Earth orbit drift modeling.

title: SpaceX's Starship makes orbital debut deploying Starlinks before early ending
author: Joey Roulette
exact_claim_supported: Independent confirmation of Flight 14 orbital reach; 26 Starlink V3 deployment; mission duration shortened from ~10h to ~3h due to upper stage issue.
limitations: News reporting confirms operational outcome; does not provide precise orbital state vectors.

title: Starship's Fourteenth Flight Test Official Mission Profile
author: SpaceX Mission Operations
exact_claim_supported: Planned profile of Flight 14 including orbital insertion; payload door demonstration; and targeted Pacific ocean splashdown.
limitations: Preflight planned timeline; actual flown mission differed due to premature on-orbit shutdown.

title: Fundamentals of Astrodynamics
author: Roger R. Bate; Donald D. Mueller; Jerry E. White
exact_claim_supported: Analytical formulation of vis-viva equation; specific orbital energy; specific angular momentum; orbital period.
data_fields_extracted: energy = v^2/2 - mu/r; h = norm(r x v); Period = 2*pi*sqrt(a^3/mu)
limitations: Classical two-body baseline for numerical invariant monitoring.

title: SciPy Integration (scipy.integrate.solve_ivp)
author: Pauli Virtanen et al.
exact_claim_supported: Adaptive Runge-Kutta (DOP853/RK45) implementation; event detection via zero-crossing root finders; tolerance controls.
limitations: Open-source numerical solver framework; requires segmented propagation at discrete maneuver boundaries.
